claims.text: The hotel sits at Hyde Park Corner, within easy reach of Buckingham Palace, Harrods, the Victoria and Albert Museum and the Natural History Museum.

findings.quote: rising grandly above Hyde Park Corner and placing guests within easy reach of Buckingham Palace, Harrods, and cultural heavyweights like the Serpentine Galleries, the Victoria and Albert Museum, and the Natural History Museum

claims.text: The building was rebuilt in 1825 as St George's Hospital by architect William Wilkins, who designed London's National Gallery.

findings.quote: the state-of-the-art St George's Hospital, rebuilt in 1825 by architect William Wilkins, the mind behind London’s National Gallery

claims.text: The Regency-era building became a luxury hotel in 1991.

findings.quote: Its final transformation came in 1991, when the grand Regency-era structure was reborn as a luxury hotel

claims.text: A 2014 restoration involved more than 300 plasterers, embroiderers, crystal specialists and other artisans.

findings.quote: followed by a lavish 2014 restoration involving more than 300 plasterers, embroiderers, and crystal specialists, among other artisans

claims.text: The hotel has been part of the Oetker Collection since 2015.

findings.quote: Since 2015, the hotel has been a jewel of the Oetker Collection

claims.text: Rooms and suites are each individually designed with Regency interiors and responsive technology.

findings.quote: are each individually designed with luxurious Regency interiors and responsive technology

claims.text: The Lanesborough Grill serves modern British dining by Executive Chef Shay Cooper.

findings.quote: The Lanesborough Grill, with modern British dining by Executive Chef Shay Cooper

claims.text: The hotel's food and drink venues include the Library Bar, the Garden Room terrace, the Withdrawing Room and The Lanesborough Grill.

findings.quote: From the vibrant Library Bar to the sunny Garden Room terrace, the stately Withdrawing Room to The Lanesborough Grill

claims.text: The hotel's cigar lounge is The Garden Room.

findings.quote: one of London's best cigar lounges, The Garden Room

claims.text: The spa has saunas, steam rooms, rain showers, a hydrotherapy pool and treatment suites.

findings.quote: saunas, steam rooms, rain showers, a hydrotherapy pool, and serene treatment suites

claims.text: The fitness center offers daily small-group classes including HIIT, boxing, TRX conditioning and reformer Pilates.

findings.quote: daily small-group classes span HIIT, boxing, TRX conditioning, and reformer Pilates

claims.text: The hotel runs events including live music, seasonal menus, cigar masterclasses and wine dinners.

findings.quote: including live music, seasonal menus, cigar masterclasses, wine dinners and more

claims.text: Every room and suite has dedicated round-the-clock butler service.

findings.quote: With round-the-clock, dedicated butler service offered in every room and suite

claims.text: The hotel has a resident Siberian Forest cat named Lilibet, after Queen Elizabeth II.

findings.quote: resident Siberian Forest cat, Lilibet — named after Queen Elizabeth II

claims.text: More than 42,000 gold leaf sheets were used for the gilding on the ceilings.

findings.quote: more than 42,000 gold leaf sheets were used for the gilding on the ceilings alone

claims.text: The Little VIP Club offers family experiences including mocktail-making classes, horseback riding and carriage rides through Hyde Park, and in-room treasure hunts.

findings.quote: Little VIP Club, a thoughtfully curated program of family-friendly experiences that includes mocktail-making classes, horseback riding and carriage rides through Hyde Park, in-room treasure hunts

claims.text: The Library Bar is known for its fine whiskies and cognacs, some dating back to 1770.

findings.quote: celebrated for its trove of fine whiskies and cognacs, some dating back to 1770

claims.text: The Lanesborough Club & Spa is open to members as well as hotel guests.

findings.quote: a prestigious health and fitness destination open to members and hotel guests

claims.text: A selection of ground-floor rooms are wheelchair accessible, with adapted bathrooms and roll-in shower cubicles.

findings.quote: A selection of ground-floor, wheelchair-accessible rooms are equipped with emergency alarm systems and adapted bathrooms featuring raised toilets, grab rails, adjustable showerheads, and roll-in shower cubicles.
